subject: Call tomorrow
text: The tutor moved our session. It is tonight now. I need to reschedule our call. Sorry for the late note. Are you free at eight? I can do six tomorrow too. I will bring my draft slides. We can split the research questions. Bring your notes. The deadline is tight. I am worried. Please text me soon. Really soon. OK. I can meet by the stairs. Or your porch. I know this is sudden. I hate the last minute shuffle. I tried the library. It is closed early. My wifi is shaky here. I need a quiet room. You offered yours yesterday. Can I still use it? I will stay brief. I can bring coffee. I can tidy up after. I will not wake anyone. Let me know by six. Thanks for understanding.
